brand.notes: Panasonic AC for PK market (Panasonic Corporation Japan; PEL distributes in PK; XKF/YE/PC/C splits + cassette + VRF ECOi). Primary sources: official Panasonic self-diagnosis error-code page (H/F names, high) + CS-E7JKEW service manual §16.3/§16.4 (causes) + NA operating manual + legacy S/E dealer-CDN compile (medium). Modern H/F self-diagnosis vs legacy inverter S/E kept in separate series files — digits collide with quarantined wired-remote E-family and are never merged across generations. No PK-localized official table (panasonic.com 403 direct; MEA PK portal has no code article; PEL/retailers publish none). Quarantines: wired-remote E-family + PACi P-codes, TV/mobile/fridge, other-brand tables, non-AC Panasonic.
